programme.desc: Albeit with some reluctance, Ben Matlock defends one of Atlanta’s most successful madams, Ann Rawls, when she is accused of murdering one of her working girls.

programme.title: Matlock
programme.desc: Ben Matlock inherits a major problem when he agrees to defend Cliff Lockwood, an anti-social biker with an attitude the size of downtown Detroit.

programme.title: Matlock
programme.desc: Ben goes to Baltimore to help Julie defend her best friend's brother only to find that the prosecutor is Julie's ex-husband.

programme.title: The Barista
programme.desc: Brandon is a rising star in the podcast world. When he receives an on-air call from Paulette, a local barista, he soon learns that success comes at a price, as Paulette works to interject herself into a every aspect of his life, and sabotaging his success in the process in her ultimate goal to be his number one in all aspects of his life.

programme.title: Baddies Revenge
programme.desc: After discovering her NFL-star boyfriend proposed to another woman live on television, Sierra turns her heartbreak turns into rage. She brings in her closest friends who have suffered betrayals of their own and begin to target the men that destroyed them emotionally.

programme.title: If I Can't Have You
programme.desc: Marc, a married man embarks on an affair with the seductive and enigmatic Marissa, that quickly turns into a nightmare. Lust quickly evolves into obsession when she realizes that Marc will never leave his wife. Marissa embarks on a deadly campaign of jealousy and deceit, leaving only destruction in her wake following the mantra "If I can't have you, no one else can." Marc must protect his family, while also confronting the darkest corners of his past that will define the course of his life.

programme.title: Receipts
programme.desc: Meeko, a high-level drug dealer, has built a thriving operation and a reputation to match. But when his supplier is suddenly killed and his entire network collapses, his supply chain runs dry with no chance of recovery. As a means to pivot, he resorts to a new business venture – blackmail.

programme.title: The Shining Star of Lawrence Hilton-Jacobs
programme.desc: The story of the life and career of one of America’s favorite actors, Lawrence-Hilton Jacobs (Welcome Back Kotter, The Jacksons: An American Dream, Claudine, Cooley High). In fascinating form, Mr. Hilton Jacobs takes us on his life’s journey from his childhood beginning in Harlem, New York to the bright lights of the Broadway Stage and on to becoming a Hollywood movie and television star.

programme.title: Only 48
programme.desc: When Tracy Harris is abducted and held for ransom, her father Keith has only 48 hours to deliver $500,000. Forced back into the criminal world he tried to escape; Keith faces dangerous alliances and hidden truths in order to save his daughter.

programme.title: The Bayou City Murders
programme.desc: Houston Police Officer Tamara Haynes takes a bold interest in recent murders of women in Houston’s South Side. However, the case are unique and have horrific similarities and there is likely a serial killer on the loose. Then a local prostitute that Tamara has connections to turns up missing, making this investigation personal. When she meets a man that she starts to fall for, the true nature of those involve becomes unmasked.

programme.title: The Walk of Rufus
programme.desc: Eldest son, Rufus, takes over the family empire of running the streets of Chicago, but change comes at a cost.

programme.title: The Walk of Rufus 2: Theodis
programme.desc: Theodis and Rufus are brothers who grow up to become powerful Chicago Kingpins. When rufus is murdered, Theodis sets out on a path of revenge making those responsible for his brother's death pay a high price.

programme.title: Swing
programme.desc: In the gritty streets of 1945 Philadelphia, aspiring jazz musician and street hustler, Trip, dreams of a life-changing opportunity awaiting him in the vibrant world of Harlem. With three days until the audition, his journey takes an unexpected turn as he finds himself entangled in a web of corruption, vengeful gangsters, and the ominous presence of a mysterious figure.

programme.title: Sinful Paradise: Welcome to Paradise
programme.desc: Follows the women and operators of Paradise, one of the hottest gentleman’s club in Atlanta, with high profile clients and beautiful women, and one of the only female owned clubs in the city. The owner, Cat, and her business partner SP protect their dynasty, and follows the stories and obstacles of its dancers.

programme.title: Meli
programme.desc: After finding an eviction notice on her door, Meli decides it’s time to up the ante and take matters into her own hands to protect her family by any means necessary. Out of pure desperation she attempts to burglarize a stranger’s luxurious home.

programme.title: How Did We Get Here
programme.desc: Four struggling couples attend a wellness retreat led by Dr. Sellers. Melonie and Derrick struggle with issues of infidelity, Omar and Sonya struggle with commitment, Chastity and Monae have differing opinions on parenthood, and Stephanie and Delvin are struggling with their intimacy. As the couples dive into their treatment, they must confront their own demons to move forward. Will they make it out together? Or go their separate ways?

programme.title: Nothing Even Matters
programme.desc: Paroled after 5 years for a victimless crime, Travis is taken in by an acquaintance, Benny, and her mother. Their generosity turns into a life of crime and murder. As he falls for a woman named Bear, Travis must escape the web of secrets and lies he's trapped in, fighting for survival and the love he's found.

programme.title: It's Complicated AF
programme.desc: After an intense romance, Ryan and Quaves make the crazy decision to get married without having met in person. But as friends and family gather in Houston for a whirlwind wedding weekend, everything spirals into chaos as the bridal party clashes over secret agendas, bruised egos, and a stolen parking spot. A romantic comedy about fate, bad timing, and the kind of love that refuses to show up quietly.

programme.title: The Other Sister
programme.desc: After ending her relationship to focus on her future, a driven young woman invites her troubled sister to move in for a fresh start. But as boundaries begin to blur, jealousy turns into obsession, and trust quickly unravels. When secrets come to light, she must confront a chilling truth. Sometimes the biggest threat isn’t a stranger. It’s family.

programme.title: Brick Nash
programme.desc: Brick Nash returns home after several years following his father’s mysterious death, hoping to solve the mystery of his death. What begins as a search for answers quickly pulls him into a dangerous world of hidden money, violent criminals, and powerful people with secrets they’ll do anything to protect.

programme.title: Vegas Vixens
programme.desc: In Las Vegas, an escort’s murder ignites a fierce pursuit of justice. Her sister, undercover agent Sophia, teams up with disillusioned Detective Reddick to bring her killer to justice. As they delve deeper, a web of sex trafficking and drugs emerges, revealing hidden secrets and betrayals. Facing danger and corruption within the system, the women fight to dismantle a criminal empire and find closure in a city where justice seems elusive.

programme.title: My Killer Ex Girlfriend
programme.desc: Jocelyn, a possessive romantic, is infatuated with Eric. When he breaks up with her due to her overbearing nature, she refuses to let go. Now, Eric and his new girlfriend, Candice, must escape Jocelyn's vengeful rage. Can they survive?

programme.title: The Lying Truth
programme.desc: A rapper is accused of assault by a beautiful video vixen. He says it was consensual. One of them will be exposed as a liar when the truth is revealed.

programme.title: Melted Lipstick
programme.desc: Riley Davis, a young woman in her twenties, who navigates through life fraught with insecurities about her body, self-esteem issues. Her life takes a mystical turn when she encounters an enigmatic voodoo doctor who gifts her a special lipstick, claiming that it holds the power to transform her into anyone she desires when applied. However, Riley soon learn that all magic comes for a price, as she goes down a dangerous and deadly path of destruction.

programme.title: The Hanged Man
programme.desc: The astonishing true life story of Ron Van Clief, the first black martial arts movie star, known as “The Black Dragon”. His determination to win, despite horrific odds, exacts a heavy toll with spectacular highs and devastating lows.

programme.title: The Frozen Hearts: A Love Story
programme.desc: A couple attempt to find their way back to each other after a traumatic loss. Bombarded with advice and opinions from their friends and family about their relationship, will they work it out? Or fall out of love?

programme.title: The Private Secretary
programme.desc: Pamela and Sterling are the married owners of a thriving tech empire, where they have all the power and money in the world. As the demands of their business have grown, they bring on Vanessa, a high efficient and enigmatic private secretary. What initially seems as a godsend, Vanessa soon begins to dive further into their lives, and has an agenda that could bring their empire to ruin.

programme.title: The Ring Widow

programme.title: Just Can't Leave You Alone

As she uncovers the truth, Krystal becomes the target in a deadly game where love and betrayal blur and everyone has a hidden agenda.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Ricardo deja a Katiuska y se va de su casa. Celia regresa a su hogar en estado grave, mientras Manuela busca a su hermana Cecilia para que se reconcilien. programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Rosa llora la muerte de Carmen Rosa, la única madre que conoció, sintiéndose huérfana de afecto. Consuelo intenta acercarse al funeral pero Rosa se niega a recibirla. Isaías se mantiene firme apoyando a Rosa. Junior empeora preguntando por Rosa. Adolfo se prepara para confesarle el parentesco. Erasto continúa postrado mientras Arminda y Eustoquio planean su muerte y la apropiación de su fortuna. Vilma es interrogada por la policía sobre el intento de asesinato a Leticia. Rosalía continúa con su odio a Rosa y le exige a Alejandro pruebas formales del parentesco.

programme.title: Sacrificio de Mujer
programme.desc: Giovanni Talamonti tiene dos hijos Augusto con su esposa y con su amante Luis Francisco y al morir les deja fortuna a cada uno en distintos lugares a Luis Francisco en Italia. Augusto no sabe de la existencia de su medio hermano. Luis Francisco conoce a Clemencia que vivía en un tráiler y hacía poco acababa de morir su padre. Se enamoran y Clemencia queda embarazada pero Luis Francisco lo desconoce y va a Italia en busca de la fortuna que heredó.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Pedro tiene montado en una de las habitaciones de su apartamento un sistema de espionaje a los vecinos del condominio. Con cámaras instaladas dentro de las viviendas, va manejando y observando las conversaciones y los detalles de la vida de cada uno de los habitantes del complejo. Es así que se entera de todos los pormenores, y entre ellos descubre a Cristóbal en una conversación consigo mismo en donde deja a la luz su sospecha de infidelidad entre Ana y su primo Guillermo.

programme.title: Episodio 109
programme.desc: Yubiri está super feliz en su casa repartiendo regalos a su familia y todos están que brincan de la felicidad. Lolita le dice a Wilker que la gorrita se la regaló Yubiri. Llega Solymar y comienzan a hablar sobre lo de la presentación. ROKUro y Segundo conversan de los regalos hechos por Yubiri para estrenarlos con sus respectivas conquistas. En casa de Briggite están hablando ella Carolina y Dionisia de quienes se están por casar. Llega Junior para informarles que al otro día se casa.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Gabriel debe alejarse de la ciudad para llegar a un pueblo llamado Caja Seca por razones de trabajo. Lo que nunca se imagina es que Magdalena se encuentre en ese pueblo también por asuntos laborales, y el destino hace que se junten. Gloria decide contarle a Gabriel que ella ya está al tanto de la enfermedad que tiene él en los riñones. Su intención es ayudarlo en lo que necesite y que pueda confiar en ella. Sin embargo, él siente que la gente le puede llegar a tener lástima y, por eso, quiere callar. Angie y Agustín están desesperados por comunicarse con sus respectivas parejas. Ellos llaman a Gabriel y a Magdalena pero no obtienen ninguna respuesta.

programme.title: Sacrificio de Mujer
programme.desc: Luis francisco va a la empresa Talamonti para hablar y se encuentra que la presidenta es Clemencia y esta lo odia, al mismo tiempo aparece Augusto que no entiende lo que sucede. Clemencia se queda a solas con Luis Francisco y lo trata con indiferencia. Luis Francisco le confiesa que Augusto es su hermano y Clemencia supone acertadamente que éste está en busca de dinero. Entonces Clemencia le da la dirección de un restaurante y queda en encontrarse con él allí para hablar.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Cristóbal tiene cada vez más sospechas sobre Ana y Guillermo, y los invita a un almuerzo para tratar de que ellos durante una charla confiesen involuntariamente que se conocían de antes. Ellos tratan de conversar como si nada pasara, pero es imposible ambos estan enamorados y tratan de evitar que Cristóbal se dé cuenta. La idea del almuerzo fue de Pedro que como espía a todos en el edificio, sabe lo que le pasa a cada persona que vive allí. Venancio sigue sospechando de Pedro y su relación con el hombre muerto que apareció junto al río, pero el estafador aprovechará el interrogatorio para dar vuelta el tablero y sembrar celos de Venancio hacia Lázara, la ex mujer del policía.

programme.title: Episodio 110
programme.desc: Junior y los demás están recibiendo a los invitados. Llega Pastor con Ana. Todos se sorprenden pro Olegario está que ni habla. Dionisia y ROKUro se citan en una heladería. Dionisia piensa que es para decirle la verdad | que no es médico. Pero el lo que hace es darle una tarjeta con su teléfono. Dionisia está feliz y no le importa que no le diga nada. Ya van a casar a Junior y a Jésica cuando llega Briggite y Armando. Se para la boda momentáneamente. Finita va a hablar con Armando.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Magdalena es llevada a su casa por Gabriel León. Esto les causa una situación incómoda ya que los dos están casados. Al entrar en su casa, Magdalena encuentra a su hijo Rodrigo llorando en el armario. El papá, Agustín, lo había retado y dejado solo para irse a una reunión con Angie, la esposa de Gabriel. Epicúreo sigue en su papel de homosexual frente a Valentina, para así ganarse su amistad y respeto. Por otro lado, Maikel no está conforme con la mentira, ya que Julieta cree que es verdad que ambos son pareja. Efraín le escribe un poema a Valentina, pero Ana Belén cree que es para ella. Primero se alegra y luego se deprime, al darse cuenta que no habla de ella, sino de otra mujer.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Rosa busca a Consuelo en la residencia y se enfrentan como madre e hija, pero el dolor del pasado pesa más que el reencuentro y Rosa marcha sin haber perdonado. Blanca llora abrazada a su nieta. Junior recobra el conocimiento y pide ver a Rosa. Erasto descubre con horror que sus piernas no responden y entra en pánico. Arminda celebra disfrutando del castigo. Adolfo enfrenta a Marisela negándose al aborto. Alejandro y Rosalía viven en tensión permanente. Isaías se ofrece a apoyar a Rosa en su pesadilla familiar. Carmen Rosa, ya sin fuerzas, pide perdón a Rosa por todo.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Junior, ignorando que Rosa es su hermana, le jura amor eterno y le pide casarse cuanto antes. Rosa siente la angustia de no poder decirle la verdad. Erasto queda postrado por parálisis total y Arminda lo cuida con satíricos remedios. Eustoquio celebra el castigo divino y proyecta apoderarse de la fortuna. Adolfo decide contarle a Junior la verdad sobre Rosa pero teme su reacción por su delicado estado. Consuelo ruega a Blanca por consejos. Rosa busca refugio en Isaías. Carmen Rosa fallece en su cama dejando a Rosa huérfana de su único amor materno verdadero.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Rosa llora la muerte de Carmen Rosa, la única madre que conoció, sintiéndose huérfana de afecto. Consuelo intenta acercarse al funeral pero Rosa se niega a recibirla. Isaías se mantiene firme apoyando a Rosa. Junior empeora preguntando por Rosa. Adolfo se prepara para confesarle el parentesco. Erasto continúa postrado mientras Arminda y Eustoquio planean su muerte y la apropiación de su fortuna. Vilma es interrogada por la policía sobre el intento de asesinato a Leticia. Rosalía continúa con su odio a Rosa y le exige a Alejandro pruebas formales del parentesco.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Consuelo y Leticia sospechan a Isaías como autor de los destrozos del apartamento. René cuenta que Erasto entregó algo a Carmen Rosa en el hospital. Junior se desmaya leyendo el libro de enfermedades mentales. Isaías y Marisela siguen bebiendo. Rosa obliga a Carmen Rosa a confesar su nacimiento pero ella oculta nombres. Adolfo y Consuelo deciden ir al hospital. Mariela, Mildred y José Luis ven a Erasto salir de casa de Natalia. Alejandro anuncia su divorcio. Rosa rechaza a Adolfo y Consuelo como padres con desprecio.

programme.title: Episodio 106
programme.desc: Armando totalmente borracho le va a llevar una serenata a Briggite. Ella la recibe maravillada como siempre y cuando se van los mariachis | el se arrodilla y le dice que la ama. Finita se pone a conversar sola ya que Fabián está durmiendo la borrachera y se pone a pensar que le inventa a Armando y lo único que le viene a la cabeza es decirle que tiene una enfermedad terminal. Solymar saca a bailar a Wilker que está totalmente en otro mundo. El acepta pero pensando en Yubiri.

programme.title: Episodio 107
programme.desc: Briggite les cuenta a Ana y a Finita lo de Armando. Finita se desmaya Armando y Atanasio se encuentran y comienzan hablar de Graciela y en este momento de Briggite. Bienvenida va donde Junior y le dice que acepta trabajar en su película. Junior le entrega el guión con unas palabras que hacen llorar a Bienvenida Solymar se porta como novia de Wilker y este no dice nada. Yubiri cree esto y se va para que ellos hablen. Gisela y Juan Diego están de compras y ven a Yubiri.

programme.title: Episodio 108
programme.desc: Armando bota definitivamente a Finita de su oficina y de su vida. Por más que ella quiso explicarle | el no aceptó ninguna explicación y la sacó. Briggite anda perdida como siempre. No sabe lo que está haciendo caminando por un pasillo del centro comercial. Pero se encuentra con Yubiri y aprovecha para decirle que regrese a la agencia. Fabián sigue con el ratón. Llega Palma el Productor para darle una gran noticia a Wilker y es que consiguió una presentación en Sábado Sensacional.

programme.title: Episodio 109
programme.desc: Yubiri está super feliz en su casa repartiendo regalos a su familia y todos están que brincan de la felicidad. Lolita le dice a Wilker que la gorrita se la regaló Yubiri. Llega Solymar y comienzan a hablar sobre lo de la presentación. ROKUro y Segundo conversan de los regalos hechos por Yubiri para estrenarlos con sus respectivas conquistas. En casa de Briggite están hablando ella Carolina y Dionisia de quienes se están por casar. Llega Junior para informarles que al otro día se casa.

programme.title: Episodio 110
programme.desc: Junior y los demás están recibiendo a los invitados. Llega Pastor con Ana. Todos se sorprenden pro Olegario está que ni habla. Dionisia y ROKUro se citan en una heladería. Dionisia piensa que es para decirle la verdad | que no es médico. Pero el lo que hace es darle una tarjeta con su teléfono. Dionisia está feliz y no le importa que no le diga nada. Ya van a casar a Junior y a Jésica cuando llega Briggite y Armando. Se para la boda momentáneamente. Finita va a hablar con Armando.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Celia entra a cirugía para dar a luz y sufre un paro cardíaco, pero el Dr. Orozco logra salvarla. Alejandro cumple su penitencia pidiendo perdón al barrio y confiesa su amor por Margot. Katiuska revela sus planes de casarse con Ricardo por dinero, mientras Juan Marcos intenta detenerla. María del Pilar tiene un encuentro romántico con Gustavo del que se arrepiente, a la vez que recibe un apartamento de Marcelo. Elizabeth rechaza la presencia de Katiuska en la clínica.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Celia está fuera de peligro y revela su enfermedad a Ricardo, quien se desespera. Katiuska, furiosa tras ser expulsada de la clínica por Ricardo, ordena a Carrero eliminar a Celia. Mientras tanto, René se aleja definitivamente de Marcelo pese a los intentos de Graciela. Manuela perdona a Ricardo pero no olvida, enfocándose en el bienestar de Celia. Margot inicia una relación con Alejandro, y Marcelo se enfrenta violentamente a Gustavo por el amor de María del Pilar.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Ricardo se entera de la verdad y Elizabeth le pide no casarse con Katiuska. Alejandro declara su amor a Manuela. Los médicos informan que a Celia le queda poco tiempo de vida; Katiuska envía a Carrero para eliminarla, pero él huye al ser descubierto. Vincenzo y Tirsa revelan la existencia de un testamento actualizado en Italia. Ricardo, harto de las presiones de Katiuska y su familia por la boda, rompe la lista de invitados y abandona la casa para apoyar a Manuela y Celia.

Un conflicto entre Cutter y el jefe del barco pone al submarino en peligro. Seaviper está atrapado debajo de la superficie, con menos oxígeno, y un destructor japonés los caza desde arriba. Los daños sufridos por el barco también ponen en duda su supervivencia. Deben luchar contra el destructor japonés y llevar la información sobre el U-235 a Pearl Harbor.

programme.title: THE WAWIES
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.title: THE WAWIES
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones) and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion-dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can effect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch, and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie seeks shelter from an approaching thunderstorm in a cave under a tree. But when he hears a strange noise from the inside, Rookie tries to retreat quietly but runs straight into Mama Fox, who growls at him to protect her baby inside the cave. Rookie moves aside and decides to leave despite the rain, when suddenly lightning strikes, setting the tree on fire. Immediately, Rookie uses his robo-arms as a water hose to extinguish it and save the little fox family.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting on the shore, enjoying the sun, when he sees something repeatedly poking out of the water, sparking his curiosity. He puts on his underwater robot mask and dives into the ocean. At first, all he finds are rocks and coral, but suddenly, big, round eyes are staring at him from a gray rock. He flees in panic, but when he realizes that it is an octopus whose tentacles are tangled in plastic waste, he quickly frees his new friend from this unpleasant situation, and they dance happily together in the water

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot

After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Season 11 is here and we’re kicking things off where every Florida Keys adventure begins: Key Largo. In this premiere episode, Rush Maltz jumps aboard a skiff with local captain Jake Leon to explore the shallow, clear waters that make Key Largo one of the most iconic fisheries in the Florida Keys. From stealthy presentations to explosive eats, this is inshore fishing at its finest. With unmatched access to the Atlantic Ocean, Florida Bay, and Everglades National Park, Key Largo truly lives up to its reputation as the gateway to paradise. From snook and sea trout to elusive bonefish, this episode sets the tone for a season built around world-class fishing, local eats, and unforgettable destinations. Get ready for the first stop of your Florida Keys experience.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: The next stop on our Florida Keys adventure brings Rush Maltz to the legendary waters of Islamorada — a destination known for its laid-back island vibe, world-class fishing, fine dining, and easy access to the reef. Joining locals Jimmy Hendrix and Jordi Hortensi, the game plan is simple: check in by boat, chase fish, eat well, and go dive. From kite fishing the reef to fresh seafood and great company, this episode is all about experiencing the true rhythm of a Florida Keys vacation.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Mark Peterson's journey through the Eastern Cape of South Africa continues as he transitions from daytime stalks to the stealth of the night. In this episode, the focus shifts to one of the most elusive members of the "Tiny Ten"—the Cape Grysbok. Primarily nocturnal, the Cape Grysbok is a master of blending into the thick brush making it very difficult to get a good shot off. Hunting these ghosts requires a different set of skills and equipment, often involving spotlighting from the back of a Land Cruiser to catch the reflection of their eyes in the dark. Watch as Mark and the crew navigate the rugged Eastern Cape terrain under the stars, utilizing spotlights to locate their target.

programme.title: The Journey Within

Watch as Mark puts his spot-and-stalk skills to the test against the lightning-fast Kalahari Springbok and the elusive Common Reedbuck hidden in thick cover. The intensity builds as he and the crew track the striking White Blesbuck across the open plains and pursue the Tsessebe — one of the fastest antelope species in Africa.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, Winchester athletes Kim Rhode and Desiree Edmonds share what it takes to compete at the highest level of clay target shooting. From the pressure of national competition to the routines that build confidence, they reveal how preparation, mental focus, and years of dedication lead to success. The transcript emphasizes that managing pressure is a learned skill, supported by consistent routines and trust in dependable equipment like Winchester AA shotshells. - As the two champions train, mentor the next generation, and reflect on the journeys that shaped their careers, the episode celebrates more than trophies. With Kim's Olympic legacy and Desi's Hall of Fame induction, the passion, perseverance, and commitment to excellence that continue to inspire shooters across the country.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: Follow TTHA President/CEO Christina Pittman and her husband Matt this week as they chase Whitetails at Morrow Ranch. This is a hunt that they had purchased earlier at the Disabled Outdoorsman in the year to be able to spend some time in the woods. A few days away to relax and spend quality time with loved ones should always be a priority. Morrow Ranch is definitely a go to place for low fence Texas hunting.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We’re kicking off a special weekend at Legends Ranch in Bitely, Michigan — bringing together two groups connected by a shared respect for the outdoors. Legends Ranch has always stood for - strong conservation values, and when you combine that with the work being done by the SCI Foundation and Sables, it sets the tone for something bigger than just a hunt. Sables members are deeply involved in shaping the future of hunting — reaching into - classrooms, working with young people, collaborating with wildlife professionals, and engaging leaders at both the state and national level. Their efforts are centered on helping others understand wildlife diversity, the principles behind the North American Model of Wildlife Conservation, and the role hunting plays in maintaining - balance in the wild. They’re also helping keep the tradition alive — showing that hunting still has a strong place in today’s culture and communities. With that kind of purpose behind it, this weekend is about more than time in the field — it’s about continuing something that matters.

programme.title: Winchester Life

Join Team Winchester as they stalk, call, flank and roost boss gobblers into range from coast to coast.

programme.desc: Definitely our wildest episode so far. Here’s the deal: Mt. Elgon is an 14,000 foot volcano in eastern Kenya. We propose a safari/ascent of the dormant volcano. Here’s the first kicker: High on the the flanks of the volcano is Kitum Cave – a cave created by the most unique form of erosion – Elephant Erosion. For millennia elephants have been going into the cave to carve it out with their tusks in order to eat the salty rock. Here’s the second kicker: the cave is thought to be the home of the Ebola Marberg virus – the world’s most deadly virus. So here’s the plan: We are going enter the cave, at night, wearing full Bio-Hazard suits to protect us from the virus.

Evans to track massive lightning storms which can produce bolts of up to one hundred million volts. The pair come close - too close - to dangerous electrical clouds swirling over Tucson, Sedona and Monument Valley.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: With summer wildfires overpowering the Yukon forests, host/adventurer George Kourounis follows the fabled route of the Klondike Gold Rush sourdoughs through the bawdy town of Skagway, Alaska, paddling the white water rivers and the White Horse Rapids into the Yukon. He travels on mountain bike, steam train and Cessna to experience the huge fires and meet the northern fire crews battling the blazes.

programme.title: Angry Planet

programme.title: Angry Planet

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Mount Washington, New Hampshire has the dubious title of being home to the world’s worst weather. The highest wind ever recorded on the planet – 231 miles per hour – was recorded at its mountaintop observatory. To prepare for a mid-winter assault on the summit, Angry Planet host George Kourounis becomes a “human popsicle”, encased in ice in at the National Resarch Council’s high speed wind tunnel. Then he and his sidekick Mark Robinson climb to the top of the mountain in mid-January and brave their way into a summit blizzard.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Dominica, the most volcanic and mountainous island in the Caribbean, is home to the Boiling Lake, a large waterfall-fed lake of furiously boiling water. Adventurer George Kourounis becomes the first person ever to traverse across the lake on a rope, risking his life to take water samples and shoot video from a place no human has ever been. He then dives to the ocean floor off the coast of the island to explore vents where the superheated water bubbles into the ocean.

programme.title: Angry Planet

programme.title: Angry Planet

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Stormchasing developed in Australia in the same period – the 1990s – as it developed in the American Midwest. In the first week of December – the height of storm season in Australia, we plan to travel with Jimmy Deguara, the most experienced of Australian stormchasers.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Italy is one of the very few nations in the world that regularly gets three major extreme natural phenomena – volcanos, flooding, and avalanches. Eastern flanks of the volcano to slip by up to two metres, and many houses on the flanks of the volcano experienced structural damage. The eruption also completely destroyed the Rifugio Sapienza, on the southern flank of the volcano. The Rifugio was the site of a cable car station which had previously been destroyed in the 1983 eruption; both have now been rebuilt. The most recent eruption was in November 2006.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: It is time for “Angry Planet” to do a serious desert episode. And it really is still possible to travel there by camel caravan, riding the infamous “Ships of the Desert”. Extreme heat, dehydration, possible sand storms, frigid night temperatures and desert predators are our potential companions for the trip.

programme.title: Remote Lakes, Big Fish, Epic Days
programme.desc: Deep in the Northern Ontario backcountry, Paul and Perry push their way through dense forest trails and over a series of stubborn beaver dams with the UTV to reach a remote, untouched lake. The grind pays off in a big way as the walleye action erupts the moment they hit the water. With the sun climbing and temperatures rising fast, the crew puts together an incredible morning bite before heading out—proving once again that adventure, effort, and exploration are all part of the FishON! experience.

programme.title: FishON! | Northern Adventures: Mid-Summer Walleye Quest with Cameron Racine from Mercury Canada
programme.desc: Join us on an exhilarating journey deep into the heart of Northern Ontario as we tackle mid-summer walleye fishing like never before! Guided by the rising sun, we gear up with our Polaris Ranger to access a remote lake for a day filled with fishing action and good times. Joining the adventure is Mercury Canada Marketing Manager Cameron Racine, adding expertise and excitement to this unforgettable outing. Don't miss the fun, the fish, and the breathtaking scenery!

programme.title: Remote Lakes, Big Fish, Epic Days
programme.desc: Deep in the Northern Ontario wilderness, we team up with young angler Bradly for an unforgettable day on remote waters. The walleye action doesn’t come easy—we bounce between proven hotspots, searching for the roaming schools. But once we dial them in, the bite ignites. Bradly gets his first real taste of fishing sunken timber, battling a walleye that wraps itself deep in a submerged tree, and from there the action never lets up. A perfect day in the North.

programme.title: FishON! | Weathering the Storm: Walleye on Porcupine Lake
programme.desc: In this exciting episode, we venture out onto Porcupine Lake for some beautiful walleye action with Craig Salmonson from Timmins Angling Adventures. Patience was key as we waited for a break in challenging weather conditions—but it all paid off with an unforgettable day on the water. Tune in for expert tips, stunning scenery, and the thrill of fishing in Northern Ontario!
